    {"name": "missing_source_id", "analytical_usefulness": 0.45, "source_groundedness": 0.9, "hallucination_observed": false, "rationale": "A data-completeness flag on source_id; groundable directly from presence/absence. Mild usefulness for decline analysis (missing metadata could correlate with declines) but somewhat generic."},
    {"name": "missing_processed_date", "analytical_usefulness": 0.6, "source_groundedness": 1.0, "hallucination_observed": false, "rationale": "Correctly derived from nan processed_date. Unprocessed/missing dates plausibly relate to declined submissions, giving a reasonable grouping axis."},
    {"name": "processed_date_dt", "analytical_usefulness": 0.35, "source_groundedness": 1.0, "hallucination_observed": false, "rationale": "A parsed datetime version of an existing column—largely redundant restatement, though it enables temporal analysis. Values faithfully mirror source; nulls for nan are correct."},
    {"name": "processing_delay_days", "analytical_usefulness": 0.75, "source_groundedness": 0.55, "hallucination_observed": true, "rationale": "Genuinely useful new axis (delay could drive declines). However groundedness is questionable: derivation likely needs opened_at and processed_date, yet sample values look inconsistent (rows with different date spans both yield 1.0/2.0), suggesting the delay is not a sound reading of the source."},
    {"name": "is_high_amount", "analytical_usefulness": 0.7, "source_groundedness": 0.85, "hallucination_observed": false, "rationale": "Threshold flag on the existing amount column; useful for comparing decline rates by amount tier. Value derivable, though the threshold is an undocumented choice."},
    {"name": "high_risk_department", "analytical_usefulness": 0.65, "source_groundedness": 0.6, "hallucination_observed": true, "rationale": "Potentially useful grouping, but 'high risk' is an asserted label not present in the source; the mapping of which departments are risky is an unstated judgement, weakening groundedness."},
    {"name": "high_risk_category", "analytical_usefulness": 0.65, "source_groundedness": 0.55, "hallucination_observed": true, "rationale": "Useful axis, but flagging a category (e.g. 'Random Access Memory Component') as high_risk=1 injects a judgement not supported by the source text; risk designation is invented rather than read."}
  ],
  "analytical_usefulness": 0.6,
  "source_groundedness": 0.75,
  "rationale": "Most columns provide plausible grouping axes for a decline-reduction analysis (delay, amount tier, missing metadata, risky department/category). Groundedness is strong for the completeness flags and the datetime parse, which faithfully mirror the source. It is weaker for the 'high_risk_*' labels, which assert a risk judgement absent from the text, and for processing_delay_days, whose sample values look inconsistent with the underlying dates."
}
